description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Ratio, responsible for validating CSS ratio values in the HTMLPurifier library. It extends the base class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef and implements specific validation logic for ratio strings, which can be single numbers or fractions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Ratio
classes.description: Class that validates CSS ratio values, which can be a single number or a fraction (e.g., '4/3'). It extends the base attribute definition class and provides the 'validate' method.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a ratio string conforming to CSS specifications. Supports single numbers or fractions separated by '/', calls external number validation method, and returns the normalized ratio string or false if invalid.
